jobs.title: Product Manager III
jobs.description:
Location:
726 Exchange Street, Buffalo New York

Job Summary
The Product Manager III is responsible for the strategic planning, development and management of new and existing product portfolios and client servicing experiences. The Product Manager III will be a subject matter expert in defining the overall business strategy and financial plan, including knowledge of industry trends, production expectations, performance, forecasting, profitability outcomes, and goals for a portfolio of products. The Product Manager III consults with senior business leaders and directs allocated resources to plan, develop, implement, and measure product and sales initiatives to increase overall product portfolio performance while adhering to the risk framework.

Essential Functions
- Responsible for the strategic design and development of new product portfolios and services that meet a client need
- Recommends new or enhanced product or portfolio pricing and value propositions, along with influencing and crafting product positioning and channel content and messaging
- Responsible for monitoring and reporting out daily, weekly, and monthly acquisition performance trends and results
- Responsible for crafting and maintaining the 1-3-5 Product Roadmap
- Responsible for understanding market conditions, the regulatory landscape and making recommendations for change as appropriate to internal and external conditions
- Accountable for the compliance and legality of all product portfolio offerings and effectiveness of distribution and delivery
- Accountable for scanning the competitive landscape, keeping a pulse on the competition with noted gaps, strengths, weaknesses and forecasting industry trends
- Accountable for forecasting accuracy, performance measurement and monitoring, and overall client experience and impacts
- Builds relationships with vendors and may manage negotiating and influencing vendor contracts
- Collaborates with Senior Marketing Consultants to manage marketing campaigns and capabilities and measures and reports out on results
- Lead business initiatives following a project plan and is responsible for outcomes
- Consult with business leaders and management to obtain buy-in and input on recommended innovations and product portfolio enhancements
- May present business cases and critical business updates to senior leadership
- May manage a small team of Product Managers and Analysts
- Performs other duties as assigned; duties, responsibilities and/or activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice
- Complies with all KeyBank policies and procedures, including without limitation, acting professionally at all times, conducting business ethically, avoiding conflicts of interest, and acting in the best interests of Key’s clients and Key.

Education
- Bachelor's Degree in business or related field and/or equivalent work experience (required)

Work Experience
- A minimum of 7 years' experience in financial services or related industry (preferred)
- A minimum of 7 years' experience in product development (preferred)

Licenses and Certifications
- Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Certified Product Manager, PMP) (preferred)

Skills
- The end-to-end oversight of a product’s lifecycle, including strategy, development, launch, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement to meet customer needs and business goals.
- A deep understanding of how the bank operates, generates revenue, and delivers value, enabling informed decision-making that supports financial and strategic objectives.
- A commitment to understanding and addressing the needs, preferences, and behaviors of customers to deliver relevant and valuable product experiences.
- The ability to generate, evaluate, and implement new ideas that enhance product offerings, improve customer satisfaction, or create competitive advantage.
- Crafting compelling narratives and visual presentations to communicate product vision, performance, and strategy to leadership and stakeholders.
- The practice of researching and interpreting market trends, customer behavior, and competitor strategies to inform product positioning and development.
- The identification, assessment, and mitigation of risks associated with product development, delivery, and compliance within the bank’s risk framework.
- The ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to evaluate product performance, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making.
- Proficiency in budgeting, forecasting, and analyzing financial metrics to ensure product profitability and alignment with financial goals.
- The skill to clearly and effectively convey product strategies, updates, and insights to stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
- The ability to work cross-functionally and build consensus among diverse teams and stakeholders to drive product success.
- The capability to lead product-related initiatives from concept through execution, ensuring timely delivery, resource alignment, and measurable outcomes.
- The ability to build, negotiate, and maintain productive relationships with third-party vendors to support product development and delivery.
- The collaboration with marketing teams to position products effectively, develop go-to-market plans, and measure campaign performance.
- A strong understanding of the regulatory environment affecting financial products, ensuring all offerings remain compliant and up to date.

Core Competencies
- All KeyBank employees are expected to demonstrate Key’s Values and abide by Key’s Code of Conduct.

Work Location Category

- Hybrid (3+ days)

This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $96,000.00 - $181,000.00 annually. Placement within the pay range may differ based upon various factors, including but not limited to skills, experience and geographic location. jobs.title: Electronic Payments Product Manager
jobs.description:
Location:
127 Public Square, Cleveland Ohio

Position Location Policy
- General Location: Cleveland, OH, Buffalo, NY, or Albany, NY required
- Hybrid Requirement (if within specific cities): If the selected candidate resides in Cleveland, OH, Buffalo, NY, or Albany, NY, or near a KeyBank office (non-branch location), they are expected to work on-site 3 days per week at the nearest location).

This position is NOT eligible for employment visa (e.g., H-1B) sponsorship. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United Stated on a full-time basis.

Job Summary
This position is part of the Commercial Payments in KeyBank’s Corporate Bank. We provide our clients with best-in-class Treasury Services inclusive of payable and receivable solutions, Liquidity Solutions, Merchant Services, Corporate Cards, Foreign Exchange, and International Trade.

The Product Manager provides support to the Sr. Core Treasury ACH & RTP Product Manager who owns the end-to-end product lifecycle —from strategy and design to delivery, performance, and ongoing optimization. In addition, this role will provide expertise in ensuring Key’s compliance with Nacha’s ACH Operating Rules & Guidelines and Real Time Payments (RTP) across the enterprise. The Product Manager will be responsible for identifying gaps in Key’s environment specific to ACH & RTP Operating rules for KeyBank as both the Originating Depository Financial Institution (ODFI) and Receiving Depository Financial Institution (RDFI). Product Manager will execute specific risk mitigation tasks and remediation plans for findings in partnership with business risk and first line of defense risk. As a key contributor on the team, this individual will also collaborate with other various stakeholders to accelerate progress towards Key’s strategic initiatives by demonstrating product expertise, risk management and socializing any changes to operating rules.

Core Responsibilities

- Partner with technology, compliance, sales, risk, and operations with ACH & RTP risk related questions

- Strengthening the control environment across Key related to ACH/Nacha Rules and RTP Operating Rules

- Ensure compliance with policies, risk, and regulatory standards related to payments.

- Execute internal and external communications for any changes to Nacha Rules or RTP Rules across the lines of business who are impacted.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS
- Function as first line of defense for KeyBank to ensure adherence to Nacha ACH Operating Rules and RTP Rules across enterprise.

- Identify and execute any internal findings / gaps related to ACH & RTP policies and procedures to support a best-in-class payable product offering, aligned with Key’s strategic initiatives.

- Ensure strict adherence with product policies and guidelines to meet all legal, compliance, and audit standards.

- Prepare business reviews to highlight findings and recommendations to management.

- Deliver training internally and externally to convey an understanding of the product’s risks. Support the sales force in selling the products and articulating the benefits to clients.

- Develop and maintain product collateral, internal procedures, client and market communications to support the sales and product rollout processes.

- May serve as a Project Manager on product-related initiatives across various channels.

- Partner with operational payment risk and first line of defense risk to lay out strategy across Key for adherence to ACH and RTP Payment Operating Rules.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education
- Undergraduate degree required, MBA preferred, or equivalent work experience

Work Experience
- Minimum 3 years of experience in financial services, risk management, or treasury management related to payments/money movement.

- Accredited ACH Professional (AAP) or 3 years of experience in ACH related operations or product and/or Accredited Faster Payment Professional (AFPP) preferred

Skills
- Strategic thinking + execution

- Data-driven decision making: Excellent problem solving and quantitative skills.

- Payment Risk expertise: Understanding of Payment Products and segment needs through demonstrated portfolio management experience.

- Communication and stakeholder alignment: Demonstrated communication. Must be able to partner across lines of business and communicate effectively across risk and compliance stakeholders.

- An ability to champion change, influence others, and foster teamwork.

- Entrepreneurial Mindset. Ability to identify business opportunities, develop a strategic plan to capitalize on those opportunities, and tactically implement the plan.

- A team player with proven ability to build strong collaborative relationships with internal partners including finance, technology, operations, sales, marketing, legal, compliance, and other internal and external partners including vendors.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office, data query, and reporting knowledge.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS
This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $80,000.00 - $150,000.00 annually. Placement within the pay range may differ based upon various factors, including but not limited to skills, experience and geographic location. Compensation for this role also includes eligibility for incentive compensation which may include production, commission, and/or discretionary incentives.

jobs.title: Enterprise GenAI Product Manager
jobs.description:
Location:
4910 Tiedeman Road, Brooklyn Ohio

Job Summary
The Enterprise GenAI Product Manager coordinates product strategy, discovery, requirements, product design, and roadmap planning for KeyBank’s portfolio of centrally supported Generative AI platforms, tools, and shared capabilities.
The role partners with Lines of Business, Shared Services, end users, governance partners, and technology teams to identify common needs and translate recurring demand into product concepts, user experiences, requirements, and roadmap priorities. This includes leading the product design and evolution of the AI Marketplace and related experiences that help employees discover, access, and use approved AI capabilities.
Serving as a central organizing point across existing and emerging enterprise GenAI capabilities, the Product Manager maintains an integrated view of how those capabilities work together, the needs they address, where they overlap, where gaps remain, and the support required for responsible adoption and growth. The role evaluates emerging tools and platform capabilities based on their potential value to KeyBank, intended users, access models, enterprise fit, and alignment with Key’s governance expectations and risk appetite.
The Product Manager partners with the GenAI Platform Engineering team, Microsoft and Google platform teams, Architecture, Governance, Risk, Information Security, and other stakeholders to move approved product concepts from discovery through design, build, launch, and ongoing enhancement.
Essential Functions
- Lead product discovery with Lines of Business, Shared Services, end users, capability owners, and governance and technology partners to identify recurring demand, common enterprise needs, and opportunities for centrally supported capabilities.
- Translate stakeholder needs and portfolio insights into product concepts, user journeys, business and functional requirements, experience designs, acceptance criteria, and prioritized roadmaps.
- Lead the product design and evolution of the AI Marketplace, enterprise prompt resources, capability catalogs, and other centrally supported GenAI products and experiences.
- Partner with the GenAI Platform Engineering team and other technical teams to translate approved product concepts and requirements into delivered capabilities through design, development, testing, release, and ongoing enhancement.
- Lead business exploration of emerging GenAI products and capabilities, including Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio LE, Agent Builder, Gemini Enterprise, Scout, evaluation platforms, and future enterprise AI offerings.
- Maintain an integrated view of the enterprise GenAI product portfolio, evaluating how platforms and capabilities interact, where they overlap, where gaps remain, and where expansion, integration, consolidation, replacement, retirement, or additional investment should be considered.
- Develop recommendations regarding product positioning, intended users, access models, priority use cases, product boundaries, rollout approaches, and readiness conditions for centrally supported GenAI tools and services.
- Evaluate proposed products and significant enhancements for employee value, enterprise fit, usability, scalability, support requirements, organizational readiness, governance and risk considerations, and compatibility with Key’s risk appetite.
- Develop business cases, product recommendations, options analyses, roadmap updates, and executive decision materials for enterprise GenAI product and capability decisions.
- Maintain current product information, including purpose, scope, target users, available capabilities, limitations, requirements, roadmap, dependencies, access and support models, ownership, and release-readiness considerations.
- Define measures of adoption, coverage, readiness, value, user experience, and capability maturity with platform, portfolio, and reporting partners. Use research, feedback, pilots, demand patterns, usage information, and platform insights to guide product enhancements.
- Coordinate product roadmaps, dependencies, handoffs, and readiness activities across Platform Engineering, Governance, Risk, Architecture, Communications & Enablement, Learning, Support, Finance, and platform-owner teams.
- Support product lifecycle decisions involving the introduction, expansion, integration, consolidation, replacement, or retirement of enterprise GenAI capabilities. Serve as a knowledgeable point of coordination for current and planned enterprise GenAI products.
- Perform other duties as assigned; duties, responsibilities, and/or activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.
- Comply with all KeyBank policies and procedures, including without limitation acting professionally at all times, conducting business ethically, avoiding conflicts of interest, and acting in the best interests of Key’s clients and Key.

Education
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, Product Design, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Work Experience
- Eight or more years of experience in product management, business analysis, platform strategy, product design, technology strategy, or a related discipline.
- Experience leading product discovery and translating stakeholder needs into product requirements, user experiences, roadmaps, and solution recommendations.
- Experience designing and evolving technology products, platforms, marketplaces, catalogs, shared services, or comparable enterprise experiences.
- Experience partnering with engineering, architecture, platform, business, and control teams throughout product design, development, release, and enhancement.
- Experience evaluating emerging technologies for enterprise value, usability, readiness, scalability, and risk.
- Experience developing business cases, product recommendations, roadmap materials, and executive decision content.
- Experience with Generative AI, emerging technology, or regulated industries preferred.

Skills
- Product discovery and stakeholder engagement.
- Product strategy and roadmap planning.
- Business and functional requirements definition.
- Product design and user experience development.
- Enterprise platform and capability evaluation.
- Product portfolio positioning and lifecycle planning.
- Business case development and decision analysis.
- Analytical problem-solving and data-informed decision-making.
- Executive communication and stakeholder influence.
- Business and technical fluency.

Core Competencies
